summary: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K describing its subsidiary United Dogecoin Inc.'s initiation of an evaluation of data center and power generation opportunities to support DOGE mining and AI workloads, along with a purchase of ElphaPex DG1+ mining units to be deployed within about 60 days at a secured site with renewable energy at $0.064/kWh. This is a routine operational update regarding a new business venture, not a special situation. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change.
